title: Agriculture Data Analysis
text:
This project uses FAOSTAT data to examine wheat, rice, and maize production in Pakistan and India between 2011 and 2023.
The analysis investigates whether production growth resulted primarily from increased crop yield or expansion of harvested land.
View the complete analysis
